sections.section: Unified Concept Editing in Diffusion Models (p. 1–19)

omissions.source: reducing offensive content can result in incomplete removal [29]; these examples highlight the limitations of relying solely on data curation.
Diffusion models were shown to mimic more than 1800 artistic styles [20].
We recognize that editing for visual features of non-binary genders risks introducing other unwanted stereotypical behavior.

distortions.source: We found ESD and SDD tend to damage the model more when erased sequentially (at 1000 iterations per concept), so we limited those techniques to random sampling-based erasure for a fixed 1000 iterations.
distortions.summary: ESD and SDD damage the model when erasing sequentially (1000 iterations per concept), so they were limited to sampling-based erasure for 1000 iterations

distortions.source: For Ablation, the authors suggest 100 iterations per concept, however we found the model deteriorates after 1000 total iterations. Therefore, we restricted Ablation to 1000 total iterations when erasing multiple concepts.
distortions.summary: SDD was limited to 700 iterations for multi-concept erasure and Ablation to 1000 total iterations, per the authors' notes on overfitting.
